text:
You can't remember your name?
No. But for some reason I remember yours.
author: Chihiro and Haku
visual_brief: A precise engineering drawing of two matched acoustic tuning forks mounted on wooden resonance chambers, facing one another across an open gap. Faint dashed concentric wave arcs travel from one fork to the other, with small motion arrows showing the sympathetic vibration carried across the silence.
alt: Engineering diagram of two facing tuning forks sharing sympathetic acoustic resonance.
